controls.name: metadata-only passthrough
controls.role: A localization result must not modify the audio path; identity audio is preserved while the angle/track is a separate annotation.

controls.name: known synthetic azimuth and TDOA
controls.role: Frozen synthetic geometry with a declared angle or delay is the minimum sanity check, not a real-array result.

controls.name: front/back and left/right mirror ambiguity
controls.role: Array geometry and estimator symmetry must report the ambiguous solution or abstain; an arbitrary mirror is not a pass.

controls.name: silence, noise-only and single-channel abstention
controls.role: A locator must abstain or report low confidence when no spatial evidence exists; a forced angle is a failure, not a valid track.

controls.name: moving-source track continuity and reset
controls.role: Track identity, gaps, re-entry and reset behavior are frozen separately from per-frame angle error.

controls.name: geometry and calibration mismatch
controls.role: Wrong spacing, orientation or channel gain must degrade confidence or abstain; silently emitting a plausible angle is not accepted.

controls.name: dropped frame and timestamp jitter
controls.role: Stale or missing channel data must not be treated as a new direction; cross-hop and timestamp calibration are part of the Spatial profile.

controls.name: same direction, different speaker identity
controls.role: Two speakers at the same angle must not be distinguished by a locator; identity or diarization is a separate category and is never inferred.

controls.name: fixed-beam versus direction-steered ablation
controls.role: Adjacent CLN-07 comparison only; steering gain cannot be relabelled as localization accuracy.
